title: R2 Evidence Intake and Risk Statement

risk_statement.risk: Identical scores across AB-0 (design) and AB-0-R1 (executed) constitute a provenance risk. Must determine whether R1 scores are independently derived from execution evidence or reused from AB-0 design estimates.
risk_statement.ab0_r1_explanation: R1 report states scores were derived from executed behavior analysis and that design scores 'happened to align.' This claim must be verified against actual evidence.
